qualification: N10.3/#384 single-variable PX4 SITL calibration: native task dwell 4.0 sim s; independent GOAL F remains position <=0.30 m, yaw <=15 deg, jointly >=3.0 sim s. Not a formal N11-N16 run.
wall_watchdog_basis: N09 repeat01/02/03/04 measured 0.740-0.747 sim/wall real-time factor over 34.9-36.7 sim seconds. Goal and hold wall watchdogs retain about 3.0x margin at that measured RTF and 1.2x margin at RTF=0.3; a stalled ROS simulation clock aborts after 15 wall seconds and enters bridge-owned landing.
dwell_calibration_rationale: The three archived independent truth windows under native dwell=3.0 were only 2.260/2.780/2.340 simulated seconds, despite wall-time durations over 3 seconds. Change only the native dwell to 4.0 simulated seconds to provide 1.0 simulated second additional completion margin; independent acceptance remains 3.0 simulated seconds.
